name: Omanote
author: Michele Belleri
description: Omanote in the bar: jot a note without opening the app, find recent notes and open them. Notes sync with Joplin Server through the Omanote app.

barWidget.description: Quick capture and recent notes. Click for the panel, right-click to show or hide the app, middle-click for a new note.

schema.label: Show the first lines of each note
